paragraphs.text: Behold! I have sent you my speech, all streaming with sweat as I am! How should I be otherwise, when sending my speech to one who by his skill in oratory is able to show that the wisdom of Plato and the ability of Demosthenes were belauded in vain? I feel like a gnat compared with an elephant. How I shiver and shake, as I reckon up the day when you will inspect my performance I am almost out of my wits!

latex.p0004: 看啊！我把我那篇演讲词送给你了，我真是汗流浃背！我怎能不如此呢？当我把这篇演讲词送给一位能以修辞技巧证明\Person{柏拉图}的智慧和\Person{德摩斯梯尼}的才能是徒受赞誉的人时，我真是如同蚊子比大象。我一想起你将审阅我的作品的那一天，就战战兢兢，几乎失去理智！
